name: bdsmartmall-platform
description: BDSMARTMALL full-stack e-commerce with Cloudflare Workers (Hono), D1 (bd-smartmall), KV (bd_smartmall), R2, Workers AI, dual customization (Drag-and-Drop + Custom HTML/CSS/JS), shoppable reels, fraud checker, CSV bulk import, dropshipping sync, multi-vendor wallet, and P&L dashboard.

scripts.db:init: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute bd-smartmall --local --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute bd-smartmall --remote --file=./schema.sql
